AND VILLAGERS CALLED THE FIRST ELECTRIC BULBS "ILYICH´S LAMPS".
THIS COLLECTIVE FARM (KOLKHOZ) IS NAMED AFTER THAT LAMP.

card_small: FIVE YEARS IN FOUR: THE SLOGAN OF 1930. THE FIRST FIVE-YEAR
PLAN HAD TO BE FINISHED A YEAR EARLY. SIBLAG IS THE SIBERIAN
CAMP ADMINISTRATION.
BY PURE COINCIDENCE A CROWD OF VOLUNTEERS HAS GATHERED HERE
TO DO HARD FORESTRY WORK FOR THE STATE, WITHOUT PAY.
SO THAT THE VOLUNTEERS REMEMBER THAT THEY ARE HERE ONLY BY
FREE WILL, THEY ARE WATCHED FROM THE AIR BY THE RADAR STATION
AND THE AIRBASE. ALL IS WELL WHEN EVERYONE REMEMBERS THAT.
captions: THE VOLUNTEERS LEAVE FOR THEIR UNPAID SHIFT.
THE WORK IS HARD, THE PAY IS ZERO, THE SPIRIT IS HIGH.
THE FOREST IS HARVESTED FOR THE STATE. IT WAS NOT CONSULTED.
THE RADAR HELPS EVERYONE REMEMBER THEIR FREE WILL.
VOLUNTEERS ARE WATCHED FROM THE AIR. FOR THEIR OWN GOOD.
NOBODY IS FORGOTTEN. ESPECIALLY NOT BY THE PARTY.
ALL IS WELL WHEN EVERYONE REMEMBERS WHY THEY ARE HERE.
